title: Colin Liotta: Rogue Puzzles: A rundown of the roguelike puzzle in the 2017 MIT Mystery Hunt

talk_title: Rogue Puzzles: A rundown of the roguelike puzzle in the 2017 MIT Mystery Hunt
description: Talk from the Roguelike Celebration 2018 - http://roguelike.club
